solution.text:
Given,

f:(0,2)→R;f(x)=x2+2x

⇒f'x=12-2x2

⇒f'x=x2-42x2

∴fx is decreasing in domain 0,2.

⇒gx=x2+2x   0<x≤132+x    1<x<2

⇒g1=12+21=52

⇒g1+=32+1=52

⇒gx is continuous in 0,2.

⇒g'x=f'x, 0<x≤11,      1<x<2

⇒g'1=f'1=-32

⇒g'1≠g'1+

So, gx is not differentiable at x=1.
